hospitals.name: Atmore Community Hospital

sample_defects.detail: Facility published standard charges in unauthorized proprietary format '.xlsx'. Under 45 CFR Section 180.50(c)(2) and CMS CY 2024–2026 OPPS Mandates (CMS-1784-F), hospitals are strictly required to publish standard charges in standardized CSV or JSON formats. Proprietary spreadsheet formats (.xlsx, .xls) are prohibited by CMS.
sample_defects.justification: Under 45 CFR Section 180.50(c)(2), hospital standard charges must be published strictly in standardized CSV (.csv) or JSON (.json) schema formats. Publishing in proprietary spreadsheet formats (.xlsx, .xls) violates federal price transparency mandates.
